description: Layer 6 Regression Resistance cases mined from real user complaints. Every case must have 0 failures before any iteration may claim Succeeded.

cases.source_complaint: Hardcoded room PIN 849201 / demo-room used as default or pre-seeded fallback in UI and src/lib/rooms/store.ts.
cases.expected_invariant: Zero occurrences of '849201' or 'demo-room' anywhere in src/ (including src/lib/rooms/store.ts). Rooms must be created dynamically via /api/rooms/create and persisted in Supabase.

cases.source_complaint: Hardcoded 'Daftar siswa (4)' / static 4 siswa counter displayed in host/studio UI instead of real connected student count.
cases.expected_invariant: Student count is strictly derived from dynamic room state (players.length), starting at 0 for newly created rooms.

cases.source_complaint: Question rows in the Question Bank / Studio table were static and unclickable, preventing teachers from inspecting options, rationales, testing answers, or editing questions.
cases.expected_invariant: Every question row in Studio / Question Bank is clickable/expandable, supports live option testing with immediate feedback, and allows custom question creation and editing.

cases.source_complaint: Legacy gold/brown palette (#CA8A04, #140D08, #1A0F0A, #F5E6D3, #331F14) caused poor contrast and ignored clean Light/Dark theme requirements.
cases.expected_invariant: Zero legacy gold/brown hex codes anywhere in src/. UI uses BoardUI semantic tokens and high-contrast Light/Dark themes.

cases.source_complaint: UI displayed 'exile.org' or 'exile-org' instead of the clean product brand 'Exile'.
cases.expected_invariant: Zero occurrences of 'exile.org' or 'exile-org' in src/app/ or src/components/. Product brand is strictly 'Exile'.

cases.source_complaint: Promotional 'Supabase Cloud' or 'Supabase' text placed in user-facing titles, badges, or footers.
cases.expected_invariant: Zero occurrences of 'Supabase' in user-facing JSX text across src/app/ and src/components/.

cases.source_complaint: Quizzes and custom questions created in Studio were not persisted to Supabase, losing data on refresh or room launch.
cases.expected_invariant: Quizzes, custom/edited questions, rooms, players, and submissions are persisted to Supabase tables and hydrated cleanly.

cases.source_complaint: Settings modal was rendered inside the sticky header with backdrop-blur, trapping the fixed overlay inside the header's stacking context.
cases.expected_invariant: Modals render via createPortal(..., document.body) or BoardUI Modal portal outside any backdrop-blur header container.
